topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The quiet of the morning was broken by the sound of chugging metal, an intruder in the stillness. I watched from behind the curtains as a tow truck hauled away my car, a familiar silhouette vanishing beyond the horizon of my driveway. The space it left behind felt vast, an emptiness that seemed to expand with each passing moment. Neighbors must have seen, their eyes possibly lingering, but the world felt distant, as if a thin veil had descended. I traced the outline of the spot where my car once stood, a specter of what’s gone, wondering when the quiet would give way to the bustle of life again.
